title: Azalea Creepers
description: This texture pack gives creepers azalea flowers!
body:
Ever wanted creepers to look a bit prettier? Well look no further, as Azalea Creepers is the pack for you!

This pack updates the creepers texture to add azalea flowers to the existing vanilla texture!

Along with giving creepers a bit more pizzazz, i've also updated the creeper spawn egg texture to match the new creeper texture!

NOTE: If you see an incompatible pack error, just ignore it, this pack should work on versions 1.21.8-1.21.10.
